shortDescription: Tests reachability using ping from devices running Juniper JUNOS

options.name: count
options.description: Number of packets to send to check reachability.

options.name: dest
options.description: The IP Address or hostname (resolvable by the device) of the remote node.

options.name: df_bit
options.description: Determines whether to set the DF bit.

options.name: interface
options.description: The source interface to use while sending the ping packet(s).

options.name: interval
options.description: Determines the interval (in seconds) between consecutive pings.

options.name: rapid
options.description: Determines whether to send the packets rapidly.

options.name: size
options.description: Determines the size (in bytes) of the ping packet(s).

options.name: source
options.description: The IP Address to use while sending the ping packet(s).

options.name: state
options.description: Determines if the expected result is success or fail.

options.name: ttl
options.description: The time-to-live value for the ICMP packet(s).
